message.content:
**Allele frequency of rs7412 (APOE ε2) in Europeans**

| Population | Allele frequency (C allele) |
|------------|------------------------------|
| All Europeans (gnomAD v2.1.1) | **≈ 0.12–0.13** (12–13 %) |
| Northern Europeans | ~ 0.14 |
| Southern Europeans | ~ 0.10 |

> **Interpretation**  
> The rs7412 SNP encodes the ε2 allele of the APOE gene. In the broad European cohort represented in gnomAD, the C allele (which defines ε2) occurs in roughly 12–13 % of chromosomes. Frequencies can vary modestly between sub‑regions (e.g., slightly higher in Northern Europe and slightly lower in Southern Europe), but the overall range remains close to 10–15 %.

**Sources**

* gnomAD v2.1.1 (European subset) – allele counts for rs7412.  
* ExAC and 1000 Genomes Project data corroborate similar frequencies (~0.10–0.15).  

If you need more granular data (e.g., by country or ancestry group), let me know!
